workloads.description: customer workload (Astera Labs); compute derived from the customer's measured profile (example profile document), TP allreduce over a 4-tile mesh

NON-LLM workload: real radio-astronomy FX correlator (Murchison Widefield Array, the SKA-Low precursor and 256-input array). 16-tile sub-array cross-correlated over 8 nodes on a 3x3 mesh. Compute is DERIVED from the published MWA correlator specification (Ord et al. 2015, arXiv:1501.05992) by a formula stated in the profile's provenance block — 30.72 MHz in 24 coarse channels, 3072 fine channels, 0.5 s integration, 4-bit complex samples
Dense demo workload: 64 ranks (TP8 x EP8) on a 64-tile mesh; TP allreduce plus EP dispatch/combine all-to-all.

workloads.display_name: GR00T N1.6 · measured H100 stage split
workloads.description: Measured GR00T N1.6 stage timings from NVIDIA's n1d6 inference timing notebook (H100 80GB): data 4.72 ms, backbone 37.96 ms, action head 94.28 ms. The HEAD notebook is relabelled N1.7 but carries the same N1.6 outputs. The 8-rank fabric and traffic profiles are authored; compute durations are measured.

MODELED, NOT MEASURED. π0 VLA pipeline using VLA-Perf roofline stage times for Jetson AGX Thor at batch 1 (vision 6.06 ms, VLM 20.30 ms, action 26.20 ms, E2E 52.57 ms; pinned upstream commit 1e2b9a7e). The 8-rank/3x3 mesh fabric, 10-step action split, and traffic profiles are authored; compute durations come from an analytical model, not hardware measurement.

AUTHORED HYPOTHETICAL 16-port switch-fabric shape, not Switchtec internals and not a PCIe protocol model. 8 host port proxies fan out to 8 SSD port proxies with synthetic 70/30 read/write traffic at 4 KB and 256 KB, an incast pair, and a multicast-equivalent duplicate-unicast class. 16 compute_tile agents model fabric ports only; no HBM and no partition isolation.
